title: [29.x][all-e]Purchase Invoice Statistics Non-Deductible VAT Amount does not match VAT Entries and G/L Entries when Non-Deductible VAT is enabled. - CopyInitial commit
summary: Fixed a calculation mismatch where purchase invoice statistics showed incorrect non-deductible VAT amounts compared to actual VAT and G/L entries when non-deductible VAT is enabled, by preserving the document's allocated amounts for manual entries.
key_points: Non-deductible VAT allocation for manual journal entries now preserves the document's rounding distribution instead of recalculating independently
Automatic journal VAT entries retain their existing calculation behavior
Fixes discrepancies that occurred when invoice lines were split by dimensions or descriptions
Added regression tests for invoices, credit memos, and prices including VAT
The issue affected purchase posting accuracy by up to 0.41 per invoice in some cases
quote: Preserve the document's allocated non-deductible VAT amounts for manual VAT entries generated by purchase posting.
